database.stem: We would like to thank all of our sponsors for their generous donations, and we hope to have your ------- support in the future.
database.raw_text:
We would like to thank all of our sponsors for their generous donations, and
we hope to have your ------- support in the future.
(A) connected
(B) consecutive
(C) continued
(D) ceaseless
database.explanation:
句意应为“希望未来能继续得到…”，故选 (C)
continued。(D) ceaseless (不停的，无休止的) 指不中断的连续状态，不
适合在这种语境下使用。
